title: Finite affine isolation of pinned NP verifier witnesses
claims: BoundedNPWitnessIsolation applies the fixed finite affine hashing count to all NP verifier witness sets using the pinned polynomial length bound and CPT relation.
Each yes-input has a good width with at least one eighth isolating seeds, while outside the language the bounded witness set is empty.
The theorem does not implement affine seed sampling or decide arbitrary NP inputs in polynomial time.
P_subset_NP is independently checked using pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
